meta.name: feishu-card
meta.description: Send rich interactive cards to Feishu (Lark) users or groups. Supports Markdown (code blocks, tables), titles, color headers, and buttons.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 向飞书用户或群组发送富交互卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在飞书中发送带格式和按钮的消息
copy.tagline_en: Send rich interactive cards to Feishu users or groups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send formatted messages with buttons in Feishu

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以发送富交互卡片到飞书用户或群聊，支持 Markdown 格式（如加粗、代码块、表格）、标题、彩色头部和按钮。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 向飞书发送消息或报告时触发，例如“给张三发一条飞书卡片消息”。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send rich interactive cards to Feishu users or groups, supporting Markdown (bold, code blocks, tables), titles, colored headers, and buttons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to send a message or report to Feishu, e.g., "Send a Feishu card to user ou_xxx".

say_en.text: Send a card to Feishu user ou_xxx with title "Weekly Report" and Markdown content.
say_en.note: Claude will send a card with a title.

say_en.text: Send a card to Feishu group oc_xxx with a red header and a button linking to https://example.com.
say_en.note: The card will have a red header and a clickable button.
